Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 4.11.2022,
cognizance order dated 13.02.2023 as well as entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.7919 of 2023
(State vs. Rakesh Agarwal and another) under Sections- 498A, 323, 506 Ipc Section 3/4 of D.P. Act,
Police Station- Mahila Thana, District Firozabad.

sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and a compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Copy of the same is annexed as Annexure No.(5) to the present application.
It is further submitted that a copy of the compromise dated 6.5.2023 has already been filed by the parties before the court below along with an application.

sentences.text: Learned AGA appearing for the opposite party no. 1 does not dispute the correctness of the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for the applicants.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, parties are directed to produce a copy of this order along with necessary papers/documents before the court below within a period of three weeks from today.
The court below is directed to fix a date for the verification of the compromise dated 6.5.2023 entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next six weeks.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of two months or till the final order passed on the compromise application by the court below whichever is earlier, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.
8. In case, the applicants are still aggrieved or if no action is taken, it will be open for the applicants to approach this Court afresh.
